name: Schloss Starkenberg
kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Starkenberg near Tarrenz captivates as a medieval castle housing the Starkenberg Brewery World, beer swimming pools, and scenic trail.
preis: Adults approx. €9.50, youth (7–15 years) €6.50, children under 7 free
oeffnungszeiten: May to October daily 10:00–17:00, November to April Mon–Fri 10:00–16:00
beschreibung:
Overview

The picturesque and historic Starkenberg Castle (Schloss Starkenberg, historically also known as Burg Neustarkenberg) rises upon a sun-drenched plateau at the foot of the massive Tschirgant mountain near Tarrenz and the town of Imst. Founded around 1310 by the powerful knights of Starkenberg, the fortress boasts a proud chivalric heritage and today houses the independent, private Starkenberg Castle Brewery. The grand ensemble of medieval defensive walls, romantic courtyards, fortified towers, and historic brew houses constitutes a unique cultural heritage landmark in the Tyrolean Oberland. With its award-winning exhibition «Biermythos» (Beer Myth), the castle has firmly established itself as a premier destination for culture and culinary travelers.

Route & Requirements

The tour through the historic fortress reveals a fascinating symbiosis between medieval defense architecture and centuries-old brewing traditions. Visitors wander through cool vaulted cellars, old malt floors, historic brew kettles, and rustic knights' halls. Numerous interactive multimedia stations and genuine artifacts explain the Bavarian Purity Law, historical brewing techniques, and the dramatic history of the contentious Starkenberg dynasty. A world-famous curiosity is found in the fermentation cellar: heated beer swimming pools where guests can bathe in warm beer yeast upon advance booking. In the castle tower, exhibits chronicle the sieges of the castle during the Appenzell Wars of the 15th century. Comfortable casual shoes are ideal for the tour.

Visit & Arrival

The Starkenberg Brewery World is open from May to October daily from 10:00 to 17:00 (winter season Monday through Friday from 10:00 to 16:00). General adult admission is approx. €9.50 including a beer tasting sample; youth tickets cost €6.50. Arrival by car: via the Inntal autobahn A12 (exit Imst) or the Fernpass road (B179) to Tarrenz, with ample parking situated right beside the castle grounds. By public transit: take the train to Imst-Pitztal railway station, connecting with local VVT bus routes directly to Tarrenz (stops Dollinger or Schulzentrum).

Tips

A hike along the renowned Starkenberg Panoramic Trail is highly recommended, passing by the castle gates and leading through the wildly romantic Salvesen Gorge. In addition, take time for a peaceful stroll to nearby Lake Starkenberg, idyllically nestled in a dense larch forest. Following your visit, the castle tavern serves hearty Tyrolean specialties and freshly pulled artisanal beers. The on-site castle shop offers regional artisan souvenirs and specialty bottled beers.
